title: Kruskal's Minimum Spanning Tree
summary: Connect every vertex as cheaply as possible without making a cycle: sort the edges by weight and take each one only if its two ends are still in different groups, tracked with union-find.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Weighted edges
inputs.hint: Edges as triples: vertex, vertex, weight (1 to 99). For example 0, 1, 4, 1, 2, 3 means 0–1 (weight 4) and 1–2 (weight 3).

inputs.name: vertices
inputs.label: Number of vertices
inputs.hint: From 1 to 8. Vertices are numbered 0 up to one less than this number.

anchors.label: Every vertex is its own group
Find the group of each end
Keep the edge and merge the groups
